name: meeting-copilot
description: Meeting copilot: hotkey captures system audio, transcribes it, and answers via Cursor.

scripts.copy:static: mkdir -p dist/overlay dist/bin dist/assets && cp src/overlay/index.html src/overlay/overlay.css src/overlay/overlay.js dist/overlay/ && cp src/assets/trayTemplate*.png dist/assets/
scripts.build:native:capture: swiftc -parse-as-library -O -o dist/bin/audio-capture native/audio-capture/main.swift -framework Foundation -framework ScreenCaptureKit -framework AVFoundation -framework CoreMedia -framework CoreAudio -framework CoreGraphics -framework CoreVideo -framework AudioToolbox -Xlinker -sectcreate -Xlinker __TEXT -Xlinker __info_plist -Xlinker native/audio-capture/Info.plist
scripts.build:native: mkdir -p dist/bin && npm run build:native:capture && npm run build:native:speech
scripts.build: tsc && npm run copy:static && npm run build:native

extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Meeting Copilot needs to capture system audio to transcribe meeting clips.
extendInfo.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Meeting Copilot uses macOS speech recognition to transcribe English meeting audio.
